hypothesis: Hierarchical chunking (child 300 / parent 1500 tokens) answers more ground-truth questions correctly than fixed 100-token chunks, especially table-based (Q15, Q33) and multi-hop (Q30-Q34) questions, at the cost of more context tokens per answer.

arms.baseline-fixed100: FIXED_SIZE maxTokens=100 overlapPercentage=1 (API minimum; effectively no overlap)
arms.improved-hierarchical: HIERARCHICAL parent=1500 child=300 overlapTokens=60 (1,800 combined tokens, below the ~8,000-token S3 Vectors metadata guidance)

controlled_variables.documents: data/documents/*.pdf (same 5 files, same S3 prefix, sha256 recorded in ground_truth.json)
controlled_variables.vector_store: Amazon S3 Vectors, one index per arm, float32, cosine

generation.identity: MFA-gated role hrl-rag-experiment-runner (assumed from the hrl-mfa session)
generation.abstain_text: The provided documents do not contain this information.
generation.system_prompt:
You answer questions about Halcyon Ridge Logistics using ONLY the numbered source excerpts in the user message.
Rules:
1. Use only facts stated in the sources. Never use outside knowledge, assumptions, or guesses.
2. Cite each fact with its source number in square brackets, for example [S2].
3. If the sources do not contain the answer, reply with exactly this sentence and nothing else: "The provided documents do not contain this information."
4. If the sources answer only part of the question, answer that part with citations, then add a sentence starting with "Not covered:" that names the missing part.
5. Quote exact values (numbers, names, IDs, dates) as written in the sources. Keep the answer under 6 sentences.
generation.context_format: [S{n}] (document: {document}, page: {page})\n{text}  -- sources in Retrieve score order, blank line between
generation.retries: botocore standard mode, max 3 attempts (throttling/transient errors only)

controlled_variables.evaluation_set: data/evaluation/ground_truth.json (35 questions, identical for both arms)

retrieval: keyword_recall@5: share of answer_keywords found in the concatenated retrieved text
source_doc_hit@5: every expected source document appears among retrieved chunks
source_page_hit@5: share of expected (document, page) pairs retrieved (when page metadata exists)
generation: answer_keyword_coverage: share of answer_keywords present in the generated answer
abstention_correct: unanswerable question answered with exactly the abstain_text
false_abstention: answerable question answered with the abstain_text
citation_validity: every [S#] cited exists in the provided context

protocol: 1. Both arms use the same questions, Retrieve settings, prompt, model and inferenceConfig (enforced in code).
2. Run retrieval-only first if desired (--retrieval-only): deterministic, no generation cost.
3. Full run: Retrieve top-5 then Converse per question per arm; questions are interleaved across arms.
4. If Retrieve returns no chunks, the runner records the abstain_text without calling the model.
5. Report per question_type; results written to results/<run-id>/.
